Product Features

  • Simple and elegant: The 60 x 40 x 180 cm white vertical display cabinet with a glossy design on the front shows simplicity and elegance, immediately enhancing the style of the living room and becoming a luminous ornament of the room.
  • Unique Appearance: A whole wall of transparent acrylic door, with LED light strip controlled by a mobile phone app. When the light is on, the items in the cabinet protrude through the transparent door, giving it mysterious beauty and creating a unique atmosphere.
  • Multi-layer storage: The interior is carefully divided into 5 storage areas, and the middle 3 layers are divided by two tempered glass partitions. Books, ornaments, collections, etc. can be stored in categories to meet different storage needs.
  • Flexible LED Light Control: The color and brightness of the LED light strip can be adjusted freely via the mobile phone app to create a lively atmosphere at gatherings and bring warm light and shadow effects to everyday life, making the living room full of life.
  • Reliable Material: Made of chipboard, it has a total load capacity of 45kg. It is robust and durable. Whether you want to place books or exquisite decorative items on it, it provides a stable hold and allows for worry-free use.
  • High Gloss Surface, Easy to Clean: The high gloss surface of the front is smooth and delicate, making it very easy to clean. Dust and stains can be removed with a light wipe, so that the display case always looks like new.
  • Transparent presentation: The transparent door design clearly presents the items in the cabinet and it becomes a small "museum" in the living room. It is not only a place to store beautiful things, but also an entertainment center to showcase collections and share hobbies. (The transparent material of the cabinet door is acrylic)
  • Space adjustment: The design with reasonable size does not take up too much space. It is suitable for placement in the corner or on the wall of the living room. It can be combined with sofas, paintings, etc. to enrich the living room and enhance the overall beauty.
  • Thoughtful details: From lighting control to multi-layered storage, from the choice of materials to the transparent door design, every detail reflects the pursuit of quality of life, giving the living room a unique charm that is both practical and beautiful.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
